decision: NX-024 (dispatcher ruling 2026-10-10): initial values from the approved design, kept as deployment configuration. self_window_seconds / self_trigger_cap bound reevaluations caused by a plan's own Run (M16: an event must not re-trigger itself indefinitely); min_reassess_seconds is the earliest a reassess_at may wake; run_budget is the ceiling of one reevaluation Run (docs/05 §6: 8 model turns, 12 tool calls, 300 s), further limited by the plan step budgets and the NX-022 model budget.
